title: Reading Drill — An Inventory for a Community Theatre
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: An Inventory for a Community Theatre
passages.body:
**A** A volunteer theatre had costumes in two rooms and a small storage shed. To avoid buying duplicates, designers were asked to check a shared inventory before ordering something for a new production.

**B** Colour and size mattered more than the costumes' former roles. The group re-labelled boxes by those details and recorded whether each garment needed a repair before it could be lent.

**C** Some very delicate garments stayed in a locked cabinet. Volunteers could still see their photographs online, but each member had to ask the wardrobe manager before taking an original out of the building.
